insert.foreach: insert into server_visit_statistic(id,server_name,max_reponse_time, min_reponse_time,ave_reponse_time,max_concurrent,visit_num,server_id) values (DEFAULT,#{entity.serverName},#{entity.maxReponseTime},#{entity.minReponseTime}, #{entity.averageTime},#{entity.maxConcurrent},#{entity.accessNum},#{entity.serverId}) ON conflict(server_id) do update set max_reponse_time = GREATEST(server_visit_statistic.max_reponse_time,#{entity.maxReponseTime}), min_reponse_time = LEAST(server_visit_statistic.min_reponse_time,#{entity.minReponseTime}), ave_reponse_time = ROUND((server_visit_statistic.ave_reponse_time + #{entity.averageTime}) / 2), max_concurrent = GREATEST(server_visit_statistic.max_concurrent,#{entity.maxConcurrent}), visit_num = (server_visit_statistic.visit_num + #{entity.accessNum})

mapper.select: select case server_status when 0 then false else true END FROM public.map_server_info WHERE layer_name = #{layer}

select server_name as serverName, server_type as serverType, count(id) as accessNum, serverinfo.description as description, serverinfo.status as serverStatus from server_request_statistic srs left join (SELECT server_name as serverName, description as description, server_status as status FROM map_server_info union SELECT server_name as serverName, description as description, status as status FROM model_server_info) serverinfo on srs.server_name = serverinfo.serverName where srs.req_start_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by server_name,server_type,description,status
select server_name as serverName, req_start_time as requetStartTime, req_end_time as requetEndTime from server_request_statistic where req_start_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT id AS id, server_type as serverType, server_name as serverName, abnormal_reason as abnormalReason, abnormal_time as abnormalTime from server_abnormal_statistic where 1=1
and abnormal_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT id AS id, cpu_rate AS cpuRate, memory_total_size AS totalSize, memory_use_size AS useSize, memory_use_rate AS useRate, record_time AS recordTime FROM sys_resource_info where record_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

select serverStatus, count(t.id) as accessNum from ( SELECT msi.server_status as serverStatus, server_id as id FROM map_server_info msi union all SELECT status as serverStatus, id as id from model_server_info ) as t group by t.serverStatus
SELECT srs.protocol_name as ogcName, count(id) as accessNum FROM server_request_statistic srs where req_start_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by protocol_name
